purpose: Frozen primary paper-comparison cohort. The JPL November 1--30, 2019 ACN file must not be acquired, inspected, or used until this configuration, the standard baseline implementations, and the comparison documentation are complete. This is a historical trace-replay experiment, not a real-time deployment or measured JPL feeder study.

acn_data_protocol.controller_information: At plug-in use the earliest complete declared kWhRequested and requestedDeparture. The later disconnectTime is a hidden environment event and must never be a controller input.
acn_data_protocol.unclaimed_session_policy: Exclude sessions without a complete initial commitment from the primary analysis.
acn_data_protocol.target_interpretation: Service ratio is delivered energy divided by user-declared requested energy, not historical delivered energy.

commitment_uncertainty.deployment_rule: At each plug-in each guard uses only JPL April calibration scores and JPL physical unplug outcomes already observed at or before that control step.
commitment_uncertainty.selection_protocol: Use only the multi_rate_envelope selected and recorded on JPL May, then replicated unchanged on JPL June and audited on JPL December. Apply it to every primary-policy replay so that controller-information differences cannot explain a result. The historical JPL November test file is not used for any selection, rate tuning, metric choice, or scenario change.
commitment_uncertainty.scope: Primary-policy comparison evidence only. Empirical coverage is operational and does not imply a finite-sample, conditional, per-driver, universal, or real-time deployment guarantee.

comparison_protocol.unit_of_inference: matched chronological calendar day; never individual EV session
comparison_protocol.shared_information_and_safety: Every primary policy receives the same declared commitment, the same causal multi-rate deadline guard, the same present-time PV-capacity source, the same station limits, and the same executed-action AC safety validation. Report raw unsafe proposals separately whenever a policy produces one.
comparison_protocol.round_robin_note: Because FairFlex models continuous power rather than discrete EVSE pilot-current increments, ideal Round Robin equals water-filled equal sharing. It remains visible for standards alignment but is not an independent primary-evidence row.
comparison_protocol.runtime_interpretation: Report median and p95 per-day runtime descriptively; do not present faster runtime as a quality improvement without hardware-controlled experiments.
comparison_protocol.forbidden_actions_after_acquisition: Do not alter a policy, guard, learning rate, metric, target definition, station mapping, feeder cap, or test window after the November file is acquired.

charging_data.station_assignment: deterministic hash of session ID across synthetic stations
charging_data.note: Real JPL sessions are mapped to synthetic feeder stations; this is an explicit experiment assumption.

solar_data.note: Fixed regional GHI resource proxy; it is not measured JPL rooftop PV output.

pv_proxy_sensitivity.note: PVWatts GHI proxy for a controlled sensitivity experiment; it is not measured JPL PV production.

feeder_sensitivity.note: Deliberately severe synthetic shared feeder-import budget; it is not a measured JPL feeder limit.
